  COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)

  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) as order_date,
  COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-11-26' AND '2025-11-30'
ORDER BY order_date
